channel.title: Daniela de los Santos
channel.description: Recent content on Daniela de los Santos

item.title: Care economy and policy
item.description: Below you can find some featured publications regarding care economy and care policy design, implementation and evaluation in the LAC region. -De los Santos, Daniela (2026). ‘Georreferenciación de cuidados en El Salvador’ and ‘Diagnósticos territoriales para la toma de decisiones’. UNDP El Salvador. Territorial care diagnostics produced with the Care Georeferencing Tool. Access the documents here. -De los Santos, Daniela (2025). ‘Care Cartographies in Latin America and the Caribbean: digital tools for designing evidence-based care policies’.

item.title: Gender, digital spaces and AI
item.description: Some of my recent work uses social media data, natural language processing and AI models to study gender inequalities in digital spaces: from violence against women in leadership positions to the digital strategies of feminist movements. -De los Santos, Daniela, Martin, Guillermina, Urriola, Ivonne & Voria, Andrea (2025). ‘Entre el menosprecio y las amenazas: análisis de violencia digital contra las mujeres en ocho países de Iberoamérica’. UNDP-LAC – Policy Notes 38.

item.title: Informal work, labor markets and gender
item.description: Here are some of my publications regarding informal work, gender and labor markets in the LAC region. -De los Santos, Daniela & Fynn, Inés (2024). ‘From Safety Net to Safety Trap: Informality and Telework During the Coronavirus Pandemic in Latin America’. American Behavioral Scientist, 68(8), 1032-1051. Read it here (open access version here). -Espino, Alma, De los Santos, Daniela & Fernández, Mayra (2022). ‘Género y mercado laboral en Uruguay y la región: secuelas de la pandemia’.

item.title: Future of work
item.description: In the framework of my labor market research, I have published a few papers regarding the ‘future of work’ dilemma: new ways of organizing labor (such as telework, electronic commerce and gig economy), the dynamics of automatization and the labor market, and the gender impacts of these phenomena. You can also explore dissemination activities and press appearences about this subject in my resume. -De los Santos, Daniela & Fynn, Inés (2024).

item.title: Poverty, vulnerability and social inequality
item.description: Below you’ll find some policy briefs, reports and book chapters regarding poverty, vulnerability and other forms of social inequality. -Madrigal, Mariela, Álvarez, Marta, De los Santos, Daniela & Pardo, Renata (2023). ‘Multidimensional Poverty Index with a focus on women: A proposal for Latin America and the Caribbean’. UNDP Global Policy Network Brief. Access it here. -Álvarez, Marta, De los Santos, Daniela & Pardo, Renata (2023). ‘Mapping the socio-economic consequences of COVID-19 in Latin America and the Caribbean and the adopted responses for recovery’.

item.title: Human mobility, urban studies and accessibility
item.description: Some of my more recent work lives in the intersection of data science, urban studies and gender analysis. See some samples below! (Notice: some of these are unpublished working papers, while others are published policy briefs and book chapters.) -De los Santos, Daniela (2025). ‘Care Cartographies in Latin America and the Caribbean: digital tools for designing evidence-based care policies’. UNDP-LAC – Policy Notes 35. Read it in English or Spanish.
